newsitem.title: CHINA: Call for China unified forex interbank market.
newsitem.headline: Call for China unified forex interbank market.

text.p: Chinese financial experts have called for the establishment of a unified inter-bank foreign exchange lending market to provide more efficient foreign exchange management for banks, Xinhua news agency reported on Sunday.

China already has a foreign exchange trading market, allowing banks to swap local for foreign currency. But there is no formal mechanism at present for banks to lend foreign exchange funds to each other.
The agency quoted the experts as telling a seminar in Beijing that such a market would improve the fund-raising ability of banks, and strengthen control of money supply.
The inter-bank business is currently full of irregularities because of a lack of unified management and adequate supervision, it added.
